name: gamemaker-kit
description: Game development workflow plugin for Claude Code. Falsify un-fun in HTML before touching the engine: 28 skills + 4 domain agents covering 4 axes (time / discipline / validation / integration). Playwright bots with 4 procedural personas + your own self-test gate, then a 6-stage HTML→Godot/Unity port re-validation. Endpoint is 'development complete' — release and live-ops are out of scope by design.
